purpose: Versioned atomic action directory for future natural-language-to-DAG compilation. Composite workflows belong in recipes, not this registry.

execution_policy.graph_execution: concurrent DAG: every node whose dependencies are complete is dispatched immediately; validation forces each same-arm pair into a dependency chain, so at most one node per arm is ever in flight
execution_policy.same_arm_exclusivity: enforced by validation, not by the scheduler
execution_policy.parallel_motion_note: two arms really do move at the same time; this library does not claim that concurrent motion is collision-free, because it models no obstacle, no swept volume and no instrument geometry. Which pairs may overlap is the graph author's call, expressed as dependencies.
